definition: Exploratory Data Analysis is a core concept in Data Analytics Using Python. It refers to the techniques, principles and practices that let a practitioner work effectively with this topic in real systems.

theory.heading: What Exploratory Data Analysis is
theory.body: Exploratory Data Analysis describes the methods and patterns used within Data Analytics Using Python to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Exploratory Data Analysis is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why Exploratory Data Analysis matters
theory.body: Without Exploratory Data Analysis, systems built with Data Analytics Using Python are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Exploratory Data Analysis works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Exploratory Data Analysis follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Exploratory Data Analysis.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Exploratory Data Analysis
theory.body: Exploratory Data Analysis offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
